review_protocol: Commit A/B choices and severe-artifact findings before opening sealed mappings.

severe_review.observations: Across all twelve rows and both unlabeled arms, text, product edges, road and railing geometry, foliage, water, artwork, fisheye boundaries and fine peacock structure remain continuous; no confirmed banding, posterization, block corruption, seam, geometry break or unintended hard clipping. Strong hue and tone changes are treated as intended style, not artifacts.

claim_ceiling: Autonomous development blind choices and severe-artifact review only; not population preference, stock response, calibration or product promotion.
